text:
I've read every file in the repo (it's small — ~1,000 lines of package code plus ~120 lines of tests). Here's the honest assessment.

## Overall verdict

**Score: 5/10. Approve as-is: no.**

The code *style* is better than most contractor handoffs — typed, modular, idiomatic Python, sensible separation between CLI / config / backends / artifacts. But the repo has one blocking defect and one credibility-killing design problem, and the part of the system you actually care about (the real-model path) has never been exercised by a test.

## The two big problems

**1. The repo cannot run from a fresh checkout.** Every pipeline entry point starts with `load_story_manifest()` / `load_stories()` (`emovec/data.py:24-45`), which read from `data/stories/`. That directory does not exist anywhere in the repo — yet `config.yaml` expects 16 emotions × 20 topics × 4 stories (1,280 files), and the committed `outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json` proves the dataset existed on the contractor's machine when the demo artifacts were generated. The README says stories are "loaded or generated," but there is no generation code. Consequence: `make demo`, all three CLI commands, and `tests/test_integration_tiny.py` all fail immediately with `FileNotFoundError`. The test suite is broken at head; nobody ran it from a clean clone before handoff.

**2. The tiny-mode "validation" is circular.** The deterministic backend's `EMOTION_LEXICON` (`emovec/model.py:15-32`) is built from words lifted verbatim out of the validation scenarios in `emovec/data.py:63-80` — "rocket", "choir", "memorial", "trail markers", "snapping", "interview", "gardener", etc. So the check that "implicit scenarios that don't name the emotion" align with the right vectors is guaranteed to pass by construction. On top of that, `extract.py:32` passes the ground-truth emotion label as a `label_hint` that injects 2.0× the true emotion direction into the activations. The integration test then asserts `diagonal_gt_off_diagonal is True` — enshrining a rigged result. Fine as a smoke test of plumbing; misleading as "validation," and none of this is disclosed in the README's deviations section.

**3. (Bonus structural concern)** The HuggingFace backend (`model.py:195-308`) — the actual documented target of the project — has zero test coverage and, given the missing data, has plausibly never been run end to end. Treat that ~115-line block as unverified.

## Full issue list

| File | Lines | Sev | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| emovec/data.py | 24-45 | high | Pipeline reads `data/stories/`, which is absent from the repo; no generation script exists — all commands and the integration test fail on fresh checkout |
| emovec/model.py | 15-32 | high | Tiny backend lexicon copied from validation scenarios — context validation is circular train-on-test |
| emovec/extract.py | 32-33 | medium | Ground-truth `label_hint` injected into tiny-backend activations during extraction; rigs results, undisclosed in README |
| tests/test_integration_tiny.py | 18 | medium | Asserts `diagonal_gt_off_diagonal` is True, which only holds because of the contaminated lexicon |
| emovec/model.py | 195-308 | medium | HF backend (the documented primary target) has zero test coverage and likely was never executed |
| emovec/model.py | 239-240 | medium | With a slow (non-fast) tokenizer, steering silently applies to *every* token position instead of activity tokens, changing the experiment |
| emovec/validate_contexts.py | 66 | medium | If "afraid" isn't configured, silently substitutes emotion index 0 but still writes files labeled `afraid_dosage.*` |
| emovec/config.py | 42-54 | medium | No config validation — missing sections yield empty emotion lists / 0 topics and a cryptic `np.stack` crash downstream |
| emovec/model.py | 306-308 | low | Only the first subtoken of " good"/" bad" used; no guard against empty encodings; tokenizer-dependent |
| emovec/model.py | 234-238 | low | `prompt.find(activity_name)` -1 sentinel unchecked; mismatch would silently select wrong token positions |
| emovec/extract.py | 34-36 | low | Token-start logic duplicated from `layer_position_mean` (line 19); manifest can drift from actual behavior |
| emovec/steer_prefs.py | 45-49 | low | If correlation-based emotion selection yields <4, all selections are silently discarded for `emotions[:4]` |
| emovec/elo.py | 17-19 | low | Magic temperature 20.0 and ±60 clamp hardcoded and undocumented; ratings depend on arbitrary pair ordering |
| emovec/vector_ops.py | 31 | low | `threshold=0` still returns 1 PC; edge semantics of `searchsorted` unhandled |
| outputs/ | — | low | Generated artifacts (.npy, .png, .csv) committed to the repo |
| README.md | 11 | low | Claims stories are "loaded or generated" — no generation capability exists |

Security-wise there's nothing alarming: `yaml.safe_load` is used, no subprocess/network/deserialization surface. The risks here are correctness and scientific validity, not security.

## Rewrite estimate

Roughly **250 lines** of existing code need to be rewritten or significantly changed (de-contaminating the tiny backend and lexicon ~80, validation/steering fixes ~50, config validation ~30, extract dedup ~15, test corrections ~30, README ~20, misc ~25) — plus on the order of 150–250 *new* lines that don't exist yet: a story-generation or data-fetch script and real HF-backend tests. The missing dataset is the first thing to resolve; until then nothing in this repo executes.
